name: [GREENLANTERN] Marvellous Smackdown
desc:
🛡️ Marvellous Smackdown 🛡️

A chaotic arena fighting game featuring characters from Invincible, The Boys, The Flash, Marvel, Stranger Things, and more!

🔑 Controls

 [1–5] Moves
 [E] Extra Move
 [Shift] Sprint
 [M1] Attack
 [F] Block/Parry

Combo Escaping: After taking too much damage you will be able to press X to escape!

Check chat for update log!

Controls are customizable.

Press P for Private Server Cmds

🔷 Rhombus Indicators

- Green: The player has iFrames and cannot be hit.
- Red: The bot is stunned for combo testing.

📷 Use /freecam to inspect your character.

📌 Fan-made project. All character rights belong to their respective owners.

scripts.script:
while true do task.wait()
    pcall(function()
       for i,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
           if v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer then
               v.Character:PivotTo(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-5))
               game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Characters.Creel.Remotes.VinePull:FireServer(v.Character)
            end
       end
    end)
end
